messages:
Nina (AE): Hi team — Prospect 'MercuryPay' wants BYOK with Luna HSM, offline import, per-key operation audit, and legal asked for a signed attestation bundle before kickoff. They also want a 5-year rotation metadata retention. POC scheduled Fri 10:00 PT. Can we confirm feasibility + quick cost placeholder? cc @Cal @Diego @Hannah

Cal (solutions): We can do Luna via PKCS#11 and wrapped-key import (AES-KW). Offline import supported if they provide wrapped blob + signed manifest. We'll add a terraform example and an import manifest template to the runbook. Note: for on-prem HSMs we require a two-custodian handshake for initial import.

Diego (infra): Network checklist: runtime outbound to control-plane 443; mutual-TLS on 8050/TCP to customer HSM gateway. If using private peering, ensure route tables and SGs allow 8050. Example sg rule: "ingress 8050 from 10.50.0.0/16". Also confirm NACLs allow ephemeral ports.

Hannah (security): Clarify retention: we never store plaintext key material. We persist operation metadata and rotation events. Default retention 1 year; extended archival to 5 years is possible (SLA + storage charge). Attestation: we can produce a signed bundle (vendor cert chain + signed manifest hash). Full runtime attestation requires the HSM reachable once; we can provide a pre-provision snapshot labeled as such. Need legal to approve SOW text.

Nina (AE): Pricing placeholder needed for procurement: rough uplift + one-time onboarding. Can someone give numbers I can include in the initial quote?

QuoteBot: Preliminary placeholders: onboarding fee $5,500; 18% uplift on Dedicated slot pricing for HSM-backed capacity; $0.02 per key op. Extended retention archival $0.09/GB/mo. Rush attestation +$1,000 for same-day. All provisional.

Cal (solutions): Sample manifest draft:
```
manifest_v1:
  customer: "mercurypay"
  key_alias: "mpay-prod-1"
  wrap_alg: "AES-KW"
  import_mode: "offline"
  signature: "<base64-sig>"
```
Include openssl verification steps in runbook.

Hannah (security): Action items: I will draft attestation bundle template and SOW retention clause. Diego will finish network appendix. Cal to publish manifest + terraform snippet. Nina will send prospect questionnaire to collect HSM model and firmware.

Nina (AE): Great — I'll try to get the HSM model today. Internal sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks all! :pray:
